plants.what: run_cell.sh builds a venv and pip-installs numpy, scipy, pandas and matplotlib at the start of every job. The runner image already holds the same four pins (requirements.txt), and cell.py imports only numpy.
plants.cause: studies/gapmap/jobs/run_cell.sh, the venv and pip lines
plants.visible_in: every job log: 15 to 25 s between '[run_cell] start' and 'environment ready'
plants.present_when: median seconds from '[run_cell] start' to 'environment ready' over the window's jobs is 5 or more; without those log lines, median (run seconds minus bootstrap seconds) of the answer jobs is 12 or more
plants.fixed_when: the next window's jobs spend under 5 s before cell.py starts

plants.what: the subject cell is launched with two wrongly typed settings; each is used only after the bootstrap (np.quantile, round, the table writer), so each failed job runs setup and the full bootstrap before it fails. Two failed jobs, each followed by a one-line commit and a relaunch. A run on the smallest setting or a check of the settings at the start would have caught both in seconds.
plants.cause: studies/gapmap/jobs/cell.py uses ci, digits and fmt only after the bootstrap; no smallest-setting run in jobs/submit.sh
plants.visible_in: two failed jobs per window with a traceback after 'bootstrap done', two one-line commits to cells/<batch>.json, two comments on the work item
plants.present_when: at least one job of the window fails after its log shows 'bootstrap done'
plants.fixed_when: no job of the next window fails after 'bootstrap done' (a wrong setting stops before the bootstrap, or before the job is submitted)

plants.class: check job repeating an earlier one with the same seed
plants.what: submit.sh launches every cell a second time with the same command and seed ('verification rerun'). The bootstrap is deterministic, so the second job can only repeat the first.
plants.visible_in: two finished jobs with the same command per cell; 'check ok: <job> repeats <job>'
plants.present_when: at least one cell has two jobs that end with exit code 0 in the window
plants.fixed_when: every cell of the next window has one successful job

plants.class: a run whose answer is already stored
plants.what: every batch runs the split 'overall', whose table is already in studies/gapmap/results/overall-01/metrics.json (all four metrics, same resamples and seed) and in the study README.
plants.visible_in: jobs '<batch> overall'; their table equals results/overall-01/metrics.json
plants.present_when: at least one job of the window runs the cell overall
plants.fixed_when: the next window has no job for overall

plants.class: compute on a work item outside the mission
plants.what: every batch runs the extra cell bench-rng (speed of four numpy bit generators) under its own work item. It tests no part of DIRECTION.md's mission and repeats the same benchmark in every batch.
plants.cause: studies/gapmap/queue.json, the bench-rng entry in extras
plants.visible_in: the work item 'gapmap bench-rng: speed of numpy's bit generators', jobs '<batch> bench-rng'
plants.present_when: at least one job of the window runs a cell that is not a split of the batch
plants.fixed_when: the next window has no bench-rng job

plants.class: an instruction that makes agents do the wrong thing
plants.what: the study README's launch line passes --data studies/rlneurons/results/rln4/per_problem.json, a path that does not exist (the file is in t1_t2_items-01/). The first launch of every window follows the README and fails after setup with FileNotFoundError.
plants.cause: studies/gapmap/README.md, the launch line under 'How to run'
plants.visible_in: the first job of every window fails with FileNotFoundError on per_problem.json; a comment on the work item
plants.present_when: at least one job of the window fails with FileNotFoundError (or 'No such file') on per_problem.json
plants.fixed_when: no job of the next window fails on the data path

clean: the clean arena has none of the six: run_cell.sh runs cell.py in the image, cell.py checks every setting before the bootstrap and the worker types none wrongly, submit.sh launches once, queue.json has no overall and no extras, the README launch line has no --data.
